leads.title: Ley Integral Para Personas Trans - Comprehensive Law for Trans Persons (Law 19,684)
leads.documents: Transgender legal status, enforcement and rights machinery: allows legal gender change with parental consent for minors, no surgery/hormones/diagnosis requirement since Oct 2018, mandates respect by authorities, housing, education, health access, 1% of scholarships, and monetary reparations for trans people persecuted during Uruguayan Dictatorship (est. ~50 people)
leads.detail: Cited as passed Oct 2018 by General Assembly 62-26 in Chamber of Representatives and 17-12 in Senate; article 4c recognizes non-binary persons in definitions but no third marker beyond female/male; Obras Sanitarias del Estado began offering jobs for trans people July 2019 in compliance; no URL visible in text

leads.title: 2009 Gender Identity Law - General Assembly law on name and legal gender change
leads.documents: Foundational trans legal status: allowed transgender people over 18 to change name and legal gender on official documents to match gender identity
leads.detail: Cited as passed Oct 2009, 51-2 vote in Chamber of Representatives and 20-0 in Senate; updated Oct 2018 to remove surgery/hormone/diagnosis requirements; no URL visible

leads.title: Law No. 19580 de violencia hacia las mujeres basada en género, Article 22
leads.documents: Intersex rights legal status: establishes protocolization of interventions regarding intersex persons, prohibiting unnecessary medical procedures for children and teenagers
leads.detail: Cited as in force since Jan 2018; no URL visible

leads.title: Law No. 19529 de Salud Mental (2017)
leads.documents: Conversion therapy ban: states in no case can a diagnosis be made in mental health field on exclusive basis of sexual orientation and gender identity
leads.detail: Cited as Adopted in 2017; no URL visible

leads.title: Penal Code Article 149ter and 2003 incitement law; 2004 anti-discrimination law creating Comisión Honoraria contra el Racismo, la Xenofobia y toda otra forma de Discriminación
leads.documents: LGBTQ enforcement and rights machinery: prohibits incitement to hatred on grounds of sexual orientation and 'sexual identity' since 2003, provides enhanced penalties for crimes motivated by sexual orientation/identity, creates Honorary Commission to investigate discriminatory conduct
leads.detail: Cited with Spanish commission name; commission intended to investigate allegations of unlawful discriminatory conduct including sexual orientation and sexual identity; no URL visible

leads.title: Ministry of Defence decree - May 2009
leads.documents: LGB military service status: gay and bisexual people allowed to serve openly after Defence Minister signed decree that recruitment would no longer discriminate on basis of sexual orientation
leads.detail: Cited as signed May 2009 by Defence Minister; no URL visible

leads.title: Family Court ruling 3 October 2018 - Karina and Fernanda vs Ministry of Education and Culture
leads.documents: Documented enforcement incident: judge ruled Ministry discriminated when it prohibited unmarried lesbian couple from listing both surnames on twin daughters' (Belen and Juliet, born via assisted reproductive technology) records; heterosexual couples not obligated to be married for same
leads.detail: Minister of Education María Julia Muñoz said would not appeal; media reported several other unmarried lesbian couples applied after ruling; no URL visible

leads.title: Faculty of Social Sciences, University of the Republic - figures on transgender Uruguayans
leads.documents: Government-academic human-rights report documenting trans marginality: ~1,000 trans Uruguayans, life expectancy 35-45 vs 77 national average, 25% left home before 18, 87% did not finish secondary school, 67% became prostitutes for income, ~75% expelled from education, only 23% formal employment, plus severe torture/sexual violence/imprisonment during Dictatorship; Sept 2018 reports six trans women died since early 2017 bill discussions
leads.detail: Institutional source cited by name; no URL visible

leads.title: State Health Services Administration (ASSE)
leads.documents: Government health report on trans safety conditions: life expectancy for transgender people just 45 years old; about two-thirds reported being victim of physical violence
leads.detail: Cited as ASSE; corroborates Faculty study disparity; no URL visible

leads.title: National Institution for Human Rights (INDDH), Medical Union of Uruguay (SMU), United Nations, Electoral Court pre-referendum record
leads.documents: Trans rights machinery under pressure: Nov 2018-Mar 2019 ~69,360 signatures collected by National Party members Carlos Iafigliola and Álvaro Dastugue for pre-referendum against trans law; INDDH warned of 'devastating impact' and setback, SMU and UN expressed concern/rejection; Catholic Episcopal Conference letter from Cardinal Daniel Sturla; pre-referendum 4 Aug 2019 failed with only ~10% participation vs required 25% (~650,000), law remains in force
leads.detail: Votes, dates, signature count and 25% threshold cited; Broad Front urged boycott citing misinformation, Popular Unity rejected referendum call; no URL visible
